div.head: Cn 1018 3
div.ab: And witena gerædnes is þæt man rihte laga upp arǽre. And æghwilce unlaga georne afille. And þæt man awéodige. 7 awyrtwalige. æghwilc unriht. swa man geornost mæge. of þisan earde. 7 arære up godes riht.

And witena gerædnes is þæt man rihte laga upp arære and æghwilce unlaga georne afille, and þæt man aweodige and awyrtwalige æghwilc unriht swa man geornost mæge of þisan earde, and arære up Godes riht.

And the decree of the councillors is that just laws be promoted, and every misdeed be zealously suppressed, and that every wrong be extirpated and eradicated from this earth, as may most zealously be done, and the justice of God be promoted.

And the council’s decree is that just laws are to be upheld and all wrongdoing is to be zealously brought low, and all injustice is to be weeded out from this land and eradicate as zealously as possible, and the law of God is to be exalted.
